annotation.summary_en: Australian vehicle standard (ADR 98/00) made under the Road Vehicle Standards Act 2018, setting advanced emergency braking requirements for passenger vehicles and light goods vehicles. Only the table of contents and metadata are visible: function, applicability, definitions, requirements, exemptions, alternative standards and an appendix.
key_provisions_or_claims: Made under the Road Vehicle Standards Act 2018 (F2021L01518, 5 Nov 2021)
Sets advanced emergency braking requirements for passenger and light goods vehicles
Includes sections on applicability, definitions, requirements, exemptions and alternative standards
